import "date"
import "dict"
import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")

cutoff = date.sub(d: 85d, from: now())
names = ["tasmota_energy_power": "Kühlschrank", "tasmota_energy_total": "Kühlschrank", "tasmota_energy_power_2": "Server", "tasmota_energy_total_2": "Server", "tasmota_energy_power_3": "Workstation", "tasmota_energy_total_3": "Workstation", "tasmota_energy_power_4": "Waschmaschine", "tasmota_energy_total_4": "Waschmaschine"]
preis = float(v: "${Strompreis}") / 100.0

load = (measurement, re, start, stop) => {
    raw = from(bucket: "sensor_data")
        |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value" and r.entity_id =~ re)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= cutoff)
    downsampled = from(bucket: "sensor_data_30m")
        |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value" and r.entity_id =~ re)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time < cutoff)

    return union(tables: [raw, downsampled])
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value), device: dict.get(dict: names, key: r.entity_id, default: r.entity_id)}))
        |> group(columns: ["device"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
}

// kWh per reading from the Tasmota counter; counter resets (negative steps) and
// implausible jumps (e.g. counter briefly reported as 0) are dropped.
consumption = (re, start, stop) => load(measurement: "kWh", re: re, start: start, stop: stop)
    |> difference(nonNegative: true)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value < 5.0)

consumption(re: /^tasmota_energy_total(_[234])?$/, start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> sum()
    |> group()
    |> sum()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: v.timeRangeStop, "Verbrauch": r._value}))

import "date"
import "dict"
import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")

cutoff = date.sub(d: 85d, from: now())
names = ["tasmota_energy_power": "Kühlschrank", "tasmota_energy_total": "Kühlschrank", "tasmota_energy_power_2": "Server", "tasmota_energy_total_2": "Server", "tasmota_energy_power_3": "Workstation", "tasmota_energy_total_3": "Workstation", "tasmota_energy_power_4": "Waschmaschine", "tasmota_energy_total_4": "Waschmaschine"]
preis = float(v: "${Strompreis}") / 100.0

load = (measurement, re, start, stop) => {
    raw = from(bucket: "sensor_data")
        |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value" and r.entity_id =~ re)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= cutoff)
    downsampled = from(bucket: "sensor_data_30m")
        |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value" and r.entity_id =~ re)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time < cutoff)

    return union(tables: [raw, downsampled])
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value), device: dict.get(dict: names, key: r.entity_id, default: r.entity_id)}))
        |> group(columns: ["device"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
}

// kWh per reading from the Tasmota counter; counter resets (negative steps) and
// implausible jumps (e.g. counter briefly reported as 0) are dropped.
consumption = (re, start, stop) => load(measurement: "kWh", re: re, start: start, stop: stop)
    |> difference(nonNegative: true)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value < 5.0)

power = load(measurement: "W", re: /^tasmota_energy_power(_[234])?$/, start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
counter = load(measurement: "kWh", re: /^tasmota_energy_total(_[234])?$/, start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

union(tables: [
    power |> min() |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: r.device, _field: "Minimum", _value: r._value})),
    power |> max() |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: r.device, _field: "Maximum", _value: r._value})),
    consumption(re: /^tasmota_energy_total(_[234])?$/, start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> sum() |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: r.device, _field: "Verbrauch", _value: r._value})),
    counter |> elapsed(unit: 1s) |> sum(column: "elapsed") |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: r.device, _field: "Sekunden", _value: float(v: r.elapsed)})),
])
    |> group()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["device"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    // Average power derived from the metered energy over the covered time span.
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        "Gerät": r.device,
        "Minimum": r.Minimum,
        "Maximum": r.Maximum,
        "Durchschnitt": if r.Sekunden > 0.0 then r.Verbrauch * 1000.0 / (r.Sekunden / 3600.0) else 0.0,
        "Verbrauch": r.Verbrauch,
        "Kosten": r.Verbrauch * preis,
    }))
    |> sort(columns: ["Gerät"])
